fact: Private member's bill no 53, tabled in the Chamber of Councillors on 17 April 2024 by the UGTM group, aims to prevent malicious uses of content generation such as deepfakes and would create a National Artificial Intelligence Agency.

fact: The Mouvement populaire group in the House of Representatives tabled a private member's bill regulating AI use that bars AI on social media from spreading false news, abusive speech or fabricated images and videos, bans unacceptable-risk systems from the market, and sets fines of MAD 50,000-500,000 and prison of 6 months to 5 years.
system: Proposed law on regulating the use of artificial intelligence
